jyutping: hou4 mou4 waan4 sau2 zi1 lik6

english.note: Use this when someone is physically unable to fight back or defend themselves during an attack.

examples.english: They were beaten until they were helpless to fight back.
examples.traditional: 佢畀人打到毫無還手之力。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 daa2 dou3 hou4 mou4 waan4 sau2 zi1 lik6
